item.title: [LOW] Generative AI Is Erasing Behavioral Tells, Weakening Behavior-Only Detection, Proofpoint Reports
item.description: Generative AI has changed what a malicious email looks like. Proofpoint shared several examples of the shift at its Protect 2026 conference.
